Name: Recycling Machine Retexture
Author: KylerFromHR
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod just changes the sprite of the Recycling Machine to look like a classic blue recycling bin. It may not make too much sense but I did it anyway. There are no gameplay changes whatsoever.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the zipped folder into your [Stardew Valley\mods] folder or use Vortex[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]What do you expect? It changes one sprite.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/strawhatwem?gameId=1303]strawhatwem[/url] for suggesting I make this mod myself.[/color][/size]
